facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_environment_simulation: run a simulation environment with a configurable duration and time increment

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.pause_environment: pause the running simulation environment and check elapsed time via time_manager

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.capture_agent_events: capture agent events using EventRegisterer capture mode to record App API calls as events
